original_value: Effective entrepreneurship education can not only cultivate students’ entrepreneurship awareness and inspire entrepreneurial potential, but also set up an entrepreneurial foundation and form entrepreneurial practice, but the current teaching system doesn’t have strong timeliness, due to the high interest of students and lack of rich teaching methods and means by college teachers. Taking “online + offline” entrepreneurship education courses as an example, an “online + offline” teaching mode based on case teaching method was developed in this paper. Based on curriculum theory, the author identified the attractive quality and must-be quality of this course by fully understanding students’ needs in the learning process of “online + offline” courses, and designed a questionnaire on the needs for the learning support services of “online + offline” course products, to understand the satisfaction degree of students corresponding to each need. At the same time, combined with the characteristics of the “online + offline” courses, by reference to the evaluation criteria of DEMATEL-ANP, course mentoring, communication, final exam, subtitles and video effect were taken as key indicators, to build an evaluation system to be used in this mode. Finally, the teaching practice proves that this mode can better increase students’ learning interest, expand the teaching content of entrepreneurship education course and improve students’ satisfaction with this course.

result.paraphrase: Effective entrepreneurship education can not only strengthen students’ entrepreneurial awareness, stimulate entrepreneurial potential, and lay a foundation for entrepreneurship practice, but the present teaching system lacks strong timeliness because students are highly interested and college teachers do not have rich teaching methods and tools. Using “online + offline” entrepreneurship education courses as an example, this paper develops an “online + offline” teaching model based on case teaching. Grounded in curriculum theory, the author, after fully understanding students’ learning needs in “online + offline” courses, identified the attractive and must-be qualities of the course and designed a questionnaire on the learning support service needs of “online + offline” course products to determine students’ satisfaction with each need. Meanwhile, in line with the characteristics of “online + offline” courses and with reference to DEMATEL-ANP evaluation criteria, course mentoring, communication, final exam, subtitles, and video effects were selected as key indicators to establish an evaluation system for this model. Finally, teaching practice shows that this model can better enhance students’ learning interest, broaden the teaching content of entrepreneurship education courses, and improve students’ satisfaction with the course.
